english.note: Use this for widespread public excitement or interest caused by an event.
Use this when an event attracts widespread attention or causes a sensation.

examples.english: The film caused a sensation throughout the city as soon as it was released.
examples.traditional: 套戲一上映就轟動全城。
examples.jyutping: tou3 hei3 jat1 soeng6 jing2 zau6 gwang1 dung6 cyun4 sing4

examples.english: This news made a splash as soon as it came out.
examples.traditional: 呢單新聞一出就轟動晒。
examples.jyutping: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 jat1 ceot1 zau6 gwang1 dung6 saai3
